value.heading: Reach Kerala's readers in Malayalam and English
value.intro: Put your brand next to trusted local, national and world news, read every day on phones and desktops. Tell us what you want to achieve and we will suggest the right formats.

cards.title: A bilingual audience
cards.text: We publish in Malayalam and English, so one campaign can speak to readers in the language they prefer.

cards.title: Kerala and Malayalis abroad
cards.text: Our focus is Kerala's districts, read across the state and, we expect, by Malayalis living elsewhere in India and in the Gulf. Ask us for the latest reader locations.

cards.title: A brand-safe environment
cards.text: Your ads appear beside edited journalism that follows our published Editorial Policy, never beside unmoderated content.

cards.title: Mobile-first readers
cards.text: The site is built for phones first: fast pages, ads that load without pushing the story around.

cards.title: Flexible formats
cards.text: Display banners, category takeovers, sponsored stories and newsletter sponsorship, alone or as a package.

cards.title: Transparent reporting
cards.text: We agree the measures with you before the campaign starts and report against them when it ends.

value.heading: Ad formats
value.intro: Display sizes are the ones our pages are built around. Send creatives at these sizes (and the mobile size where given) so they fit without cropping.

cards.title: Homepage banner
cards.text: A wide banner between the sections of the homepage, the most-visited page of the site.

cards.title: Sidebar
cards.text: Beside the Most Read and Trending lists on article and section pages, on desktop.

cards.title: In-article
cards.text: Inside the story, after the third and seventh paragraphs of longer articles.

cards.title: Category pages
cards.text: Within the story lists of a section such as Keralam, Sports or Business: reach readers by topic.

cards.title: Sponsored story
cards.text: An article about your organisation or campaign, written or approved to our editorial standards and always labelled “Sponsored”.

cards.title: Newsletter sponsorship
cards.text: A clearly marked sponsor message in our email newsletter.

body.value:
• Every sponsored story, video or newsletter message is labelled Sponsored, on the page and wherever it is shared.
  • Sponsored stories are written or approved under our editorial standards: no false claims, no misleading headlines, no attacks on competitors.
  • Sponsored content is never made to look like our news reporting, and advertisers have no say over our news coverage.
  • We may decline any advertisement or sponsored content that breaks the law or our policies.

Read the full rules in our Editorial Policy.

steps.title: Enquire
steps.text: Tell us about your brand, goals, budget and dates with the form below.

steps.title: Proposal
steps.text: We reply with suggested formats, placements, timing and a quote.

steps.title: Creative and approval
steps.text: You send the creatives (or we prepare a sponsored story with you). We check them against our ad and editorial policies before anything goes live.

steps.title: Campaign live
steps.text: Your campaign runs on the agreed pages and dates.

steps.title: Report
steps.text: At the end you receive a report against the measures we agreed.

value.title: Media kit
value.description: Audience, formats, sizes and rates in one PDF.

items.question: Is there a minimum spend?
items.answer: It depends on the formats and how long the campaign runs. Tell us your budget in the form and we will suggest what fits it.

items.question: Can I target a section or a language?
items.answer: Yes. Display ads can run on chosen sections (for example Keralam, Sports or Business) and we can tell you which placements reach Malayalam or English readers. Ask us what is available for your dates.

items.question: What creative specifications do you accept?
items.answer: Images (JPG, PNG, WebP or GIF) or HTML5 at the sizes listed under Ad formats. Keep files light so pages stay fast; we will confirm the exact file limits in the proposal.

items.question: What are the payment terms?
items.answer: Payment terms are set out in each proposal and agreed before the campaign starts. Prices are subject to GST where applicable.

items.question: Do you approve ads before they go live?
items.answer: Yes. Every ad and sponsored story is checked before it goes live. We do not run ads that are misleading, unlawful or that imitate news reporting (see our Editorial Policy).

items.question: Will I get a report?
items.answer: Yes. We agree what we will measure before the campaign starts and send a report when it ends.

value.heading: Tell us about your campaign
value.intro: Share as much as you can; we reply by email with suggestions and a quote.

body.value: Prefer email? Write to desk@example.com. For anything else, use our Contact page.

seo.title: Advertise With Us
seo.description: Advertise on Digital Truth News Network: display ads, sponsored stories and newsletter sponsorship for Malayalam and English news readers in Kerala. Ask for a proposal.
